report.summary: Alert EVAL-13 triggered by NDR on host SRV-BKP-01 for regular outbound connections to an external host. Investigation confirms this activity is authorized administrative traffic generated by the licensed CorpBackup backup agent (backupagent.exe) communicating with its vendor server. Past alerts for the exact same indicators were previously resolved as false positives.

claims.text: The alerting tool reported regular outbound connections to an external host on host SRV-BKP-01.
Process backupagent.exe (PID 2400) runs as a Windows service from C:\Program Files\CorpBackup\backupagent.exe, spawned legitimately by services.exe under NT AUTHORITY\SYSTEM.
The process established 12 outbound HTTPS connections to 203.0.113.80:443 (backup.corp-vendor.example) uploading approximately 40.6 MB of data at regular 300-second intervals.

Historical review shows that both the destination IP address 203.0.113.80 and domain backup.corp-vendor.example were previously associated with false positive alert PA-2026-0915 caused by periodic backup agent uploads.

recommended_next_steps: Close alert EVAL-13 as a false positive due to authorized backup software activity.
Verify the CorpBackup service configuration and schedule on SRV-BKP-01 to confirm it matches organizational backup policies.
Cross-reference the vendor IP address and domain with internal IT asset management records to ensure they are documented as approved backup endpoints.
